What We Built

Get Lucky × Indwe Risk Services — a compact, forward-looking view of what we've built, what we've learned, and where the partnership goes next.

January – August 2026
In short

We missed the conversion targets. We built something far bigger.

Eight months in, the original hole-in-one conversion model has not delivered the new business we projected. We are not going to dress that up.

What we have built together is a national platform, a fully automated golfer-to-golfer pipeline, and a set of partnerships that turn this from a South African sponsorship into a scalable global product.

05 · What we've learned

The leads are real. The conversion model was wrong.

01The key insight: these golfers are affluent, already insured, and usually already have a broker.
02It's a positioning and journey challenge, not a lead problem. The first touch has to spark curiosity, not feel like a pitch.
03A free swing is a brilliant hook. On its own it is not a reason to move a decade-old insurance relationship.
04So we stopped optimising the funnel and started building the platform. That is where the compounding value sits — and where the last four months have gone.

07 · Why the partnership makes strategic sense

Not just hole-in-1s. Let’s own golf.

01We're reaching the right audience. Affluent leads are real and flowing — the most difficult part of any insurance funnel is already working.
02Get Lucky is central to Indwe's growth — front and centre in two of the strategic initiatives — affluent leads and partnerships.
03The model compounds. A recurring membership relationship + national broadcast + the Get Lucky Golf app + 150,000 golfers means reach that grows season on season.
04The platform now reaches past the fairway. The app and founding-partner alliances take Indwe’s association with golf from 30+ par 3s into every player’s pocket — locally, then internationally.
05A phased, honest route to returns. Year-1 new business has not landed the way we modelled. But the database, the app and the partner network are assets that compound — and the international route changes the economics of this partnership entirely.
★ Our MissionIndwe will drive growth through the Get Lucky brand engagement engine, becoming the trusted insurance broker for golfers across South Africa.

09 · The proposal

Help us go global — and South Africa runs at no cost.

01Where we are. The Year-1 hole-in-one conversion model has not delivered the new business we projected. We own that, and we are not asking anyone to pretend otherwise.
02What we built instead. A national platform, an automated pipeline, the world's first hole-in-1 app, and founding partnerships with Ernie Els and Icons Cup SA. Together we have built a global product, not a local sponsorship.
03What we are asking for. Introductions to international insurance partners. Indwe's credibility and network in this industry open doors that ours cannot.
04What Indwe gets. Continued exclusive access to South Africa's most affluent golfers — the brand, the database, the app and the pipeline — with the cost taken off the table, alongside the modelled R28.8m brokerage line as the app scales internationally.
★ The OfferIf Indwe helps us sign sponsorship deals with international insurance partners, we will continue the South African partnership at no cost to Indwe.
